events.title: The Louisiana Purchase Is Formally Completed
events.description: In a ceremony in New Orleans, France handed over the Louisiana territory to the United States. This completed the land deal that Napoleon's government had agreed to earlier that year.
events.significance: The transfer roughly doubled the size of the United States. It opened the way to westward expansion and reshaped the nation's future.

events.title: Spanish Prime Minister Carrero Blanco Is Assassinated
events.description: Admiral Luis Carrero Blanco, a close confidant of dictator Francisco Franco, was killed in Madrid. The Basque separatist group ETA carried out the attack.
events.significance: Carrero Blanco was seen as Franco's likely successor. His death shook the regime and came shortly before Spain's transition to democracy.

events.title: The United States Invades Panama
events.description: Operation Just Cause began when US forces entered Panama under President George H. W. Bush. The operation deposed dictator Manuel Noriega and ended on January 31, 1990.
events.significance: It was one of the largest US military operations after the Vietnam War. It was also the first major one of the post-Cold War era, and it set the tone for later debates over intervention.

events.title: Portugal Hands Macau Back to China
events.description: Portugal transferred sovereignty of Macau to China after more than four centuries of Portuguese presence. Macau became a special administrative region with its own legal, monetary and immigration systems.
events.significance: It marked the end of the last European colony in Asia. It also showed China's 'one country, two systems' model in practice.
